description_en: Parses the logical table dependencies of an offline compute node. The parsing result may contain self-dependent nodes in the upstream dependency information, where the upstream node ID is the same as the node ID of the parsed code. You must handle such cases on your own
description_zh: 解析离线计算任务的逻辑表依赖，注意解析结果上游依赖信息中可能包含自依赖节点（上游节点ID和解析代码的任务节点ID相同）需要用户自己进行处理
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public parse-batch-task-dependency --op-tenant-id 30001011 --parse-command NeedQueryLineages=true DataSourceSchema=erp ProjectId=131211211 IncludeAllInputTables=true Code=select_0_from_t_test_limit_1 OperatorType=MaxCompute_SQL DataSourceId=12131111 DataSourceCatalog=mysql_catalog --region cn-hangzhou
name: ParseBatchTaskDependency

fields.help_en: The SQL code to be parsed
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include dependency information for input tables that have no corresponding nodes. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 包含未找到对应节点的输入表的依赖信息, 默认 false
fields.name: include_all_input_tables

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to query data lineage when querying upstream dependencies. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 查询上游依赖时是否查询血缘数据, 默认 false
fields.name: need_query_lineages

fields.help_en: The node type, such as MAX_COMPUTE_SQL
fields.name: operator_type

fields.help_en: The data source ID for a database SQL node
fields.name: data_source_id

fields.help_en: The catalog for a database SQL node. This parameter takes effect only for data source types that require a catalog, such as Presto
fields.help_zh: 数据库sql任务，仅对如Presto等需要设置Catalog的数据源类型生效
fields.name: data_source_catalog

fields.help_en: The schema for a database SQL node. This parameter takes effect only for data source types that require a schema, such as Oracle
fields.help_zh: 数据库sql任务，仅对如Oracle等需要设置Schema的数据源类型生效
fields.name: data_source_schema
